# ghost_repository (Data Source)

Looks up a Ghost repository, either by `full_name` or by `name` (with an optional `owner`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a repository by its full name.
data "ghost_repository" "by_full_name" {
  full_name = "my-org/example"
}

# Look up a repository by its slug. The owner defaults to the authenticated user.
data "ghost_repository" "by_name" {
  name = "example"
}

# Look up a repository by owner and slug.
data "ghost_repository" "by_owner" {
  owner = "my-org"
  name  = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `full_name` (String) The repository's full name, `owner/slug`. Set this, or `name` (and optionally `owner`), to choose the repository to look up.
- `name` (String) The repository's slug, as reported by the Ghost API. When looking up by `name`, this is the slug rather than a display name. Cannot be combined with `full_name`.
- `owner` (String) The user or organization that owns the repository. When looking up by `name`, defaults to the authenticated user. Cannot be combined with `full_name`.

### Read-Only

- `clone_url` (String) The HTTPS clone URL.
- `created_at` (String) When the repository was created, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `default_branch` (String) The default branch.
- `description` (String) The repository's description, null when it has none.
- `fork` (Boolean) Whether the repository is a fork.
- `html_url` (String) The repository's web URL.
- `id` (String) The repository's full name, `owner/slug`.
- `node_id` (String) The GraphQL node ID.
- `private` (Boolean) Whether the repository is private.
- `pushed_at` (String) When the repository was last pushed to, as an RFC 3339 timestamp. Ghost reports the creation time for a repository that has never been pushed to.
- `repo_id` (Number) The numeric repository ID.
- `slug` (String) The repository's URL-safe name.
- `ssh_url` (String) The SSH clone URL, empty when SSH is unavailable.
- `updated_at` (String) When the repository was last updated, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `visibility` (String) Either `public` or `private`.
